description: This script is part of the OpenWRT platform-specific code for the bcm63268 target, handling firmware upgrade procedures based on board names, with functions for checking and performing upgrades.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of the firmware image; always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the platform-specific upgrade process, selecting the appropriate upgrade method based on the board name.
